名义：刚提名省服，你让我退休？
不拱火我来汉东干什么？

observed_opening_patterns.finding: Popular fast openings often begin after the event has already started: confrontation, physical danger, relationship rupture, institutional attack, or rule test. They do not spend a page proving that the premise is reasonable.
Within the first few hundred Chinese characters the protagonist usually performs an observable action that reveals temperament and changes the situation, rather than only thinking or debating.
The opening repeatedly cycles action -> visible consequence -> new pressure/information -> next action. A chapter is not one dilemma stretched across 2000 words.
The first chapter normally pays off at least one promised competence, reversal, joke, survival rule, retaliation, intimacy beat or status change before asking the reader to continue.
The protagonist's sell is often legible from what they do under pressure: provoke, retaliate, manipulate, survive, refuse, exploit a rule, or choose aggressively.
Multiple meaningful state changes occur in one 1800-2800 character chapter. Exposition is attached to immediate use.
Current high-read titles frequently use chapter titles and endings as explicit action/result promises; the next click is tied to a concrete upcoming event.

concrete_examples.title: 作精不吸血后，恋爱脑糙汉追着亲
concrete_examples.opening_sequence: Opens inside an intimate confrontation; within ~30 lines the heroine learns her fatal future; she immediately interrupts the act physically; the same chapter turns into money/dependency/breakup conflict. The chapter keeps converting information into action.

concrete_examples.title: 诡舍2
concrete_examples.opening_sequence: Establishes a dangerous abnormal street and known survival rule; protagonist chooses to walk through it; the entity confronts and attacks; protagonist demonstrates rule-based composure and survives the test within chapter one.

concrete_examples.title: 不拱火我来汉东干什么？
concrete_examples.opening_sequence: First sentence is already an argument in a meeting; protagonist's provocative personality is demonstrated through speech/action immediately; conflict and comic consequence arrive before background explanation.

concrete_examples.title: 名义：刚提名省服，你让我退休？
concrete_examples.opening_sequence: The first chapter establishes an imminent promotion, political opposition, protagonist competence/status, then ends by concretely freezing the promotion—clear loss creates the next action.

phase408_root_correction.previous_error: We treated premise validation as if a strong one-line moral/relationship dilemma were sufficient for fast web fiction.
phase408_root_correction.stronger_diagnosis: The missing unit is an executable opening event engine: live event + protagonist action + consequence + revaluation/payoff + next forced action.
phase408_root_correction.why_batch3_failed: L/M/O are static decision tableaux. They describe meaningful histories and one choice, but do not demonstrate a chain of escalating state changes or a protagonist whose behavior itself is enjoyable to follow.

boundary.do_not_copy: Do not mechanically imitate sexual shock, extreme violence, systems, rebirth, political fan-fiction or other genre devices simply because current hits use them.
boundary.transferable_structure: Imitate event density, early agency, short causal loops, same-chapter payoff, strong behavioral character signal and concrete next-action pressure.
